title: Term Life Insurance Terminal Illness Advances and the Policy Lien
content:
**Claims manual — Term Life Insurance accelerated death benefit.**

An approved terminal illness accelerated benefit claim is paid as an advance and placed on the policy as a lien. The advance entry appears on the policy's activity history under the approved claim, the policy's outstanding acceleration lien becomes the lien amount, and the claim is marked completed.

Before the lien is worked out, the accidental death rider amount on record must already be zero for an insured whose anniversary age has reached the rider expiry age.

The advance is paid only once the policy status on record has returned from lapsed to in force.

## Invocation: `pay_accelerated_advance_7c43a05b`

**Capability.** Pays a terminal illness accelerated benefit advance on one Ashgrove term policy and places its lien: one advance entry carrying the lien amount supplied is added to the policy's activity history under the approved accelerated benefit claim, the policy's outstanding acceleration lien becomes that amount, and the claim is marked completed.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `term_policy_id` | The reference number of the term policy being accelerated, read from the term policy lookup before the call | Identifier, as recorded |
| `term_request_id` | The reference number of the approved accelerated benefit claim, read from the service request lookup before the call | Identifier, as recorded |
| `lien_amount` | The lien placed on the policy | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places; the tool rounds half to even to the cent if more are given |
| `payout_method` | How the advance is paid to the owner | `check` — a mailed check; `direct_deposit` — a deposit to the owner's bank account; `beneficiary_access_account` — settlement into an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("advance_paid" on success), `advance_id` (the reference number of the new advance entry), `term_policy_id`, `term_request_id`, `lien_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `payout_method` (the method used) and `request_status` (always "completed").
